values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-001
values.comment: manufacturerIdentification is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time. At least one manufacturerName, manufacturerTradeName or manufacturerTrademark must exist.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-002

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-003
values.comment: manufacturerTradeName must be a String. It must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-004
values.comment: manufacturerTrademark must be a String. It must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-005
values.comment: manufacturerPostalAddress must be a String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-006
values.comment: manufacturerContactDetails is an optional field. It must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-007
values.comment: manufacturerWebsite must be a URL and it is an optional field. It must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-008
values.comment: manufacturerEmail must be a URL and it is an optional field. It must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-009
values.comment: batteryCategory must be a List of codes: battery-category and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-010
values.comment: batteryIdentification is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time. At least one of modelIdentifier and batchNumber, or serialNumber, or productNumber, or otherIdentificationElement must exist.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-011
values.comment: modelIdentifier must be an Identifier. It is a mandatory field if batchNumber exists. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-012
values.comment: batchNumber must be an Identifier. It is a mandatory field if modelIdentifier exists. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-013
values.comment: serialNumber must be an Identifier. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-014
values.comment: productNumber must be an Identifier. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-015
values.comment: otherIdentificationElement must be an Identifier. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-016
values.comment: manufacturingPlace is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time. At least one manufacturingCity or manufacturingRegion must exist.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-017
values.comment: manufacturingCity must be a String. It must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-018
values.comment: manufacturingRegion must be a String. It must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-019
values.comment: manufacturingCountry must be a string containing a three-letter code and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-020
values.comment: manufacturingDate must be a date with format Year and month and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-021
values.comment: batteryWeight must be a Decimal and Unit (kilogram or gram), and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-022
values.comment: batteryCapacity must be a Decimal and Unit (ampere hour or milliampere hour) and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-023
values.comment: batteryChemistry must be a List of codes: battery-chemistry. It is a mandatory field and it could occur more than one time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-024
values.comment: hazardousSubstances must be a String. It is a mandatory field and it could occur more than one time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-025
values.comment: extinguishingAgent must be a multilingual String. It is a mandatory field and it could occur more than one time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-026
values.comment: criticalRawMaterials must be a List of codes: critical-raw-material. It is a mandatory field and it could occur more than one time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-027
values.comment: nominalVoltage must be a Decimal and Unit (volt), and an optional Value Range with Unit (celsius) and Observed Characteristic (Temperature). It is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-028
values.comment: maximumVoltage must be a Decimal and Unit (volt), and an optional Value Range with Unit (celsius) and Observed Characteristic (Temperature). It is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-029
values.comment: originalPowerCapability must be a Decimal and Unit (watt). It is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-030
values.comment: powerLimit must be a Decimal and Unit (watt), and an optional Value Range with Unit (celsius) and Observed Characteristic (Temperature). It is a mandatory field, and it could occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-031
values.comment: expectedLifetimeCycles must be a positive Integer. It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-032
values.comment: cycleLifeReferenceTest must be a multilingual String. It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-033
values.comment: capacityExhaustionThreshold must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB subgroup), and must not exist in LMT and IND subgroups.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-034
values.comment: notInUseTemperatureRange must contain a Value Range with Unit (celsius) and Observed Characteristic (Temperature). Is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-035
values.comment: notInUseTemperatureRangeTest must be a multilingual String. It is a mandatory field. it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-036
values.comment: commercialWarrantyPeriod must be a Integer. It is an optional field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-037
values.comment: initialRoundTripEnergyEfficiency must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-038
values.comment: roundTripEfficiencyAtHalfCycleLife must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-039
values.comment: internalCellResistance must be a Decimal and Unit (ohm). It is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-040
values.comment: internalPackResistance must be a Decimal and Unit (ohm). It is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-041
values.comment: cycleLifeChargeCRate must be a Decimal and Unit (reciprocal hour). It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-042
values.comment: cycleLifeDischargeCRate must be a Decimal and Unit (per hour). It is an optional field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-043
values.comment: separateCollectionSymbol must be a Boolean with value "TRUE" (if YES), and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-044
values.comment: chemicalSymbol must be a List of codes: battery-chemical-symbol. It is an optional field, and it could occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-045
values.comment: euDeclarationOfConformity must be a RelatedResource. It is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-046
values.comment: wasteBatteryPreventionManagementInfo is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-047
values.comment: endUserRoleInWastePrevention must be a multilingual String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-048
values.comment: endUserRoleInSeparateCollection must be a multilingual String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-049
values.comment: separateCollectionPoints must be a multilingual String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-050
values.comment: takeBackCollectionPoints must be a multilingual String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-052
values.comment: preparationForReuseFacilities must be a multilingual String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-053
values.comment: preparationForRepurposingFacilities must be a multilingual String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-054
values.comment: wasteBatteryTreatmentFacilities must be a multilingual String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-055
values.comment: wasteBatterySafetyInstructions must be a multilingual String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-057
values.comment: batteryLabelSymbolMeaning must be a multilingual String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-058
values.comment: batterySubstancesImpact must be a multilingual String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-059
values.comment: detailedComposition must be a multilingual String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-060
values.comment: sparePartReplacementDetails must be a RelatedResource. It is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-061
values.comment: dismantlingInformation must be a RelatedResource. It is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-062
values.comment: safetyMeasures must be a RelatedResource. It is a mandatory field. It must occur only one time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-063
values.comment: complianceTestReportResults must be a RelatedResource. It is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-064
values.comment: ratedCapacity must be a Decimal and Unit (ampere hour or milliampere hour). It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-065
values.comment: capacityFade must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-066
values.comment: powerCapability must be a Decimal and Unit (watt). It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-067
values.comment: powerFade must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-068
values.comment: internalResistance must be a Decimal and Unit (ohm). It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-069
values.comment: internalResistanceIncrease must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-070
values.comment: roundTripEnergyEfficiency must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is an optional field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-071
values.comment: roundTripEnergyEfficiencyFade must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is an optional field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-072
values.comment: expectedLifetimeCyclesRest must be a Integer. It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-073
values.comment: expectedLifetimeYears must be a Integer. It is a mandatory field, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB and LMT subgroups). It is an optional field (IND subgroup), it must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-074
values.comment: stateOfCertifiedEnergy must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is mandatory, it must occur only 1 time (only EVB subgroup), and must not exist in LMT and IND subgroups.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-075
values.comment: remainingCapacity must be a Decimal and Unit (ampere hour or milliampere hour). It is a mandatory field -it must occur only 1 time- (only LMT subgroup), an optional field -it must occur only 1 time- (only IND subgroup), and must not exist in EVB subgroup.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-076
values.comment: remainingPowerCapability must be a Decimal and Unit (watt). It is a mandatory field -it must occur only 1 time- (only LMT subgroup), an optional field -it must occur only 1 time- (only IND subgroup), and must not exist in EVB subgroup.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-077
values.comment: remainingRoundTripEfficiency must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is a mandatory field -it must occur only 1 time- (only LMT subgroup), an optional field -it must occur only 1 time-(only IND subgroup), and must not exist in EVB subgroup.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-078
values.comment: selfDischargingRateSet must be a selfDischargingRate and recordedTime. It is a mandatory field -it must occur only 1 time- (only LMT subgroup), an optional field -it must occur only 1 time- (only IND subgroup), and must not exist in EVB subgroup.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-080
values.comment: selfDischargingRate must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is a mandatory field and it could occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-081
values.comment: ohmicResistance must be a Decimal and Unit (ohm). It is a mandatory field -it must occur only 1 time- (only LMT subgroup), an optional field -it must occur only 1 time- (only IND subgroup), and must not exist in EVB subgroup.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-082
values.comment: batteryStatus must be a List of codes: battery-status and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-083
values.comment: numberOfChargingCycles must be an Integer. It is an optional field and it could occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-084
values.comment: numberOfDischargingCycles must be an Integer. It is an optional field and it could occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-085
values.comment: negativeEvents must be an multilingual String. It is an optional field and it could occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-086
values.comment: environmentalConditionHistogramSet must be a environmentalConditionHistogram. It is an optional field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-087
values.comment: environmentalConditionHistogram must contain observedCharacteristic, binValueUnit, binRangeUnit and bin. It is a mandatory element inside environmentalConditionHistogramSet and it could occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-088
values.comment: stateOfChargeHistogram must contain binValueUnit, binRangeUnit and bin. It is an optional element and it could occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-089
values.comment: registrantIdentity must be a String and it is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-090
values.comment: renewableContentShare must be a Decimal and Unit (percent). It is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

values.label: SEM-BAT-MSG-091
values.comment: minimalVoltage must be a Decimal and Unit (volt), and an optional Value Range with Unit (celsius) and Observed Characteristic (Temperature). It is a mandatory field. It must occur only 1 time.

enumerations.label: Common Error Code Vocabulary
enumerations.comment: Vocabulary of error codes that describe errors in validation derived from the use of common supporting attributes.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-001
values.comment: observedCharacteristic is a List of Codes: observed-characteristic. It is a mandatory element.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-002
values.comment: binRangeUnit is a List of Codes: measurement-unit. It is a mandatory element.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-003
values.comment: binValueUnit is a List of Codes: measurement-unit. It is a mandatory element.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-004
values.comment: bin contains lowerBound, upperBound and binValue. It is a mandatory field, and it could occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-005
values.comment: lowerBound is a decimal and it is a mandatory field.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-006
values.comment: upperBound is a decimal and it is a mandatory field.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-007
values.comment: binValue is a decimal and it is a mandatory field.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-008
values.comment: valueRange contains lowerBound, upperBound, Unit and observedCharacteristic as mandatory fields.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-009
values.comment: value is a Decimal.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-010
values.comment: unit is a List of Codes: measurement-unit.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-011
values.comment: recordedTime is a dateTime.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-012
values.comment: All Strings with language datatype must follow the format: two (2) characters language code as in ISO 639:2023 and two (2) characters country code as in EN ISO 3166-1:2020.

values.label: SEM-COM-MSG-013
values.comment: The field {{field}} is not defined in the vocabulary.

enumerations.label: Common Supporting Vocabulary
enumerations.comment: Vocabulary of common supporting concepts used by digital product passport data models.

values.label: Bin
values.comment: A bucket within a histogram representing either a value interval or a category and its associated quantity.

values.label: Bin range unit
values.comment: The unit of measurement used for the values defining the histogram bin intervals on the X-axis.

values.label: Bin value
values.comment: The value associated with a histogram bin, represented on the histogram's Y-axis.

values.label: Bin value unit
values.comment: The unit of measurement of the quantity represented by the histogram bin values on the Y-axis.

values.label: Lower bound
values.comment: The lower limit of a numerical interval represented by a histogram bin or applicable range.

values.label: Observed characteristic
values.comment: The characteristic, property, or condition described.

values.label: Recorded time
values.comment: Time when the value was recorded (timestamp).

values.label: Unit
values.comment: Unit in which a value or range is expressed.

values.label: Upper bound
values.comment: The upper limit of a numerical interval represented by a histogram bin or applicable range.

values.label: Value
values.comment: Value associated with a measurement.

values.label: Value range
values.comment: Range of values (contains lowerbound and upperbound)

enumerations.label: Core Error Code Vocabulary
enumerations.comment: Vocabulary of error codes that describe errors in validation derived from the use of core attributes.

values.label: SEM-MSG-001
values.comment: digitalProductPassportId must be a String and must occur at least 1 time and must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-MSG-002
values.comment: uniqueProductIdentifier must be a String and must occur at least 1 time and must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-MSG-003
values.comment: granularity must be a code of granularity-level (only item for batteries) and must occur at least 1 time and must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-MSG-005
values.comment: dppStatus must be a List of codes: instance-status and must occur at least 1 time and must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-MSG-006
values.comment: lastUpdate must be a dateTime and must occur at least 1 time and must not occur more than 1 time.

values.label: SEM-MSG-009
values.comment: contentSpecificationIds must be a list of content specification IRIs and must include exactly one IRI for each applicable content specification (core, product group and, if applicable, subgroup).

enumerations.label: Digital Product Passport Core Vocabulary
enumerations.comment: Vocabulary of core concepts used by digital product passport data model.

values.label: contentSpecificationIds
values.comment: Identifiers of content specifications, schemas or data models that govern the structure of the digital product passport content.

values.label: contentType
values.comment: Media type or format of a digital resource.

values.label: DigitalProductPassport
values.comment: A set of data specific to a product that includes the information specified in the applicable delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4 and that is accessible via electronic means through a data carrier in accordance with Chapter III - Regulation (EU) 2024/1781;

values.label: digitalProductPassportId
values.comment: Identifier of an instance of the digital product passport.

values.label: dppStatus
values.comment: The current lifecycle status of a digital product passport.

values.label: granularity
values.comment: The level at which a unique product identifier applies, such as model level, batch level or item level.

values.label: language
values.comment: Language in which information associated is expressed.

values.label: lastUpdate
values.comment: Date and time at which a digital product passport was most recently modified or updated.

values.label: resourceTitle
values.comment: Human-readable title assigned to a digital resource.

values.label: uniqueProductIdentifier
values.comment: Unique character string that identifies a product.

values.label: url
values.comment: Uniform Resource Locator providing electronic access to a digital resource.

enumerations.label: Instance Status Vocabulary
enumerations.comment: Vocabulary of digital product passport instance status concepts.
